gloss: unpaid amount; outstanding balance; accounts payable

definitions.gloss: unpaid amount; outstanding balance; accounts payable
definitions.explanation: Money that is owed but has not yet been paid. In everyday use it is an overdue bill or arrears; in accounting it is a balance-sheet liability for goods or services already received.

examples.japanese: {未払|みはら}い{金|きん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There is still an unpaid balance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未払|みはら}い{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{今月中|こんげつちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}した→約束する：05643_yakusokusuru⟧。
examples.english: The company promised to pay the outstanding amount within this month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{取引先|とりひきさき}→取引先：11083_torihikisaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{未払|みはら}い{金|きん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資金|しきん}{繰|ぐ}り→資金繰り：07998_shikinguri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦|くる}しく→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When unpaid amounts owed to suppliers pile up, a company's cash flow becomes strained.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) plus ⟦{払|はら}い→払い：18738_harai⟧ (payment) plus {金|きん} (money). The prefix ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ is highly productive: ⟦{未使用|みしよう}→未使用：21316_mishiyou⟧ (unused), ⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧ (undecided).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未払|みはら}い{金|きん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: for an unpaid balance to remain
- {未払|みはら}い{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{請求|せいきゅう}する→請求する：26988_seikyuusuru⟧: to demand payment of an outstanding amount
- {未払|みはら}い{金|きん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回収|かいしゅう}する→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧: to collect an unpaid amount

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未収金|みしゅうきん}→未収金：30183_mishuukin⟧: uncollected receivable — money owed *to* you, the mirror image of {未払|みはら}い{金|きん}
- ⟦{滞納|たいのう}→滞納：09323_tainou⟧: delinquency, arrears — stresses that a payment is overdue, often of rent, taxes, or fees
